data.name: Under Destruction
data.detailed_description:
Roadmap

1. Narrative Quest Line
We will develop a complete and engaging quest line designed to expand the lore and guide players through a coherent and content-rich narrative progression.

2. Multiplayer Mode
We will implement multiplayer by leveraging the features of the Steam SDK, introducing:
• Online co-op, to experience the game together with friends.
• Online PvP modes, to challenge friends in high-intensity combat.
• LAN support, currently under evaluation.

3. Expansion of Game Environments
We will continue improving and expanding the environments of Under Destruction:
• Refinement of existing maps.
• Creation of new areas inspired by the current lore and designed to offer new strategic challenges.

4. High-Tension Extraction Scenarios
We will introduce secondary game contexts based on high-tension extraction dynamics: targeted sessions without saving, designed to increase risk and adrenaline.
These scenarios will not represent a main game mode, but will enrich the experience with optional, high-risk, high-impact challenges.

5. New Units and Weapons
We will add additional enemy types and new weapon systems to expand strategic possibilities and enrich combat.

6. Connection to the “7 Years Later” Project
Future updates will introduce narrative elements that connect Under Destruction to our upcoming project “7 Years Later”, a title that will tell the conflict from the human perspective.


About the Game

Under Destruction is an action, strategic, and tactical game where every engagement demands analysis and preparation. Victory is not based on reflexes alone, but on the ability to plan ahead, read the battlefield, and make deliberate decisions before combat begins. The challenge level is high and requires focus, knowledge of your tools, and a clear understanding of enemy threats. Game systems are deep and layered, designed to be learned and mastered over time. Failure is part of the process, and the game rewards those who persevere, accept the challenge, and return to the field better prepared.

Explore the territory, locate, capture, and convert refineries. Energy is the core resource that powers every system in the game: weapon production, drone upgrades, and the deployment of allied units. Expanding your control means managing structures, optimizing production, and organizing your forces with intent.

Battles are intense, fast paced, and destructive, but never predictable. Each engagement requires tactical thinking, threat assessment, flanking maneuvers, and coordinated use of allied units. Quick decisions and proper positioning determine whether you advance or are pushed back.
Capturing enemy outposts demands precise choices. Understanding which structures to strike first is essential to limit enemy capabilities, reduce battlefield pressure, and gain a tangible advantage in subsequent encounters.

In Under Destruction, every battle reflects the choices made beforehand. The difference between dominating the territory or losing it comes down to how well you prepared.

Total Destruction

Nothing is invulnerable. Every structure, wall, or building can be torn apart by your firepower.
Battles reshape the environment in real time, opening new sightlines and tactical opportunities.
Use destruction as a weapon: the battlefield changes, and you can force it to change with you.

Open Worlds, Endless Choices

Explore vast open-world territories, each with unique environments and dedicated threats.
Every map offers different objectives, structures to capture, and strategies to uncover.
Face game modes that shift pace and approach, from territorial conquest to focused operations.

High-Intensity Tactical Combat

Choose your arsenal from weapons with distinct styles and functions, each capable of reshaping the flow of battle.
Face human units with unique behaviors, from heavy armored vehicles to fast and unpredictable targets.
Deploy allied drones and support units, each with specific roles to coordinate on the field.
Combine firepower, support, and mobility to dominate every encounter with strategic precision.

Large-Scale Events in Real Time

The battlefield is alive and unpredictable: nuclear blasts, carpet bombings, and dynamic events can change everything in seconds.
Structures, terrain, and sightlines are reshaped by the devastation, creating new opportunities or sudden threats.
Adapt quickly to evolving conditions and use the chaos to gain a decisive tactical edge.
In Under Destruction, any battle can shift in an instant.

data.short_description: You are Spyro, a combat drone deployed by AXIS against human forces. Capture and convert refineries to generate energy, upgrade equipment and allied units, plan each engagement, and eradicate the enemy through strategy and territorial control.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 x64 / Windows 11 x64
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-7700K / AMD Ryzen 5 1600X
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GeForce GTX 2060 6GB / AMD Radeon RX 5600 XT 6GB
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 x64 / Windows 11 x64
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-11700 / AMD Ryzen 7 5800X
  • Memory: 32 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GeForce RTX 3070 Ti / Nvidia GeForce RTX 4070 / AMD Radeon RX 6800 XT
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
